quarterly_data.signal: Further detail of the EVX-01 Phase 2 two-year data in advanced melanoma: 12 of 16 patients had objective clinical responses (ORR 75%), four with a complete response; no relapses were observed at two years; 54% of patients had a deepened response during treatment; tumor reduction (target lesions) was seen in 15 of the 16 patients; and EVX-01 induced an immune response in all patients. EVX-01 was given with MSD's anti-PD-1 KEYTRUDA (pembrolizumab) in the first two years; in a one-year extension a subset of patients received EVX-01 as stand-alone therapy, and those three-year data are to be presented at ESMO 2026.
